															Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025 Syllabus 📝

															Prelims Exam Plan and Syllabus 📝

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025
																
																
																Paper: General Knowledge & Law
																
																
																Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰
																
															

															Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠

															
																
																Total Questions: 50
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪
																	
																	
																	(2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍
																	
																	
																	(3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️
																	
																	
																	(6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️
																	
																
																
																
																Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics.
																
															

															Part-II: Law ⚖️

															
																
																Total Questions: 100
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: 30 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(2) The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: 25 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023: 25 Marks 👮
																	
																	
																	(4) U.P. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025
																
																
																Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination.
																
																
																Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳
																
															

															Written Examination

															
																
																Total Papers: 6
																
																
																Total Marks: 500
																
																
																Paper Details & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖
																	
																	
																	(2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠
																	
																	
																	(4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️
																	
																	
																	(5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚

																	
																		
																		"Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts: 

																		
																			
																			(i) Arms Act, 1959
																			
																			
																			(ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
																			
																			
																			(iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
																			
																			
																			(iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
																			
																			
																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Personality Test 🗣️

															
																
																Marks: 50 Marks
																
																
																Note: The suitability of candidates will be determined by keeping in mind their efficiency, character, personality, and physical fitness.
																
															

															General Note:-

															
																
																The general knowledge syllabus is identical for both the preliminary and main examinations.
																
																
																The merit list will be prepared by adding the marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination and interview. 🏆

															Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025 Syllabus 📝

															Prelims Exam Plan and Syllabus 📝

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025
																
																
																Paper: General Knowledge & Law
																
																
																Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰
																
															

															Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠

															
																
																Total Questions: 50
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪
																	
																	
																	(2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍
																	
																	
																	(3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️
																	
																	
																	(6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️
																	
																
																
																
																Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics.
																
															

															Part-II: Law ⚖️

															
																
																Total Questions: 100
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: 30 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(2) The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: 25 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023: 25 Marks 👮
																	
																	
																	(4) U.P. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025
																
																
																Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination.
																
																
																Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳
																
															

															Written Examination

															
																
																Total Papers: 6
																
																
																Total Marks: 500
																
																
																Paper Details & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖
																	
																	
																	(2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠
																	
																	
																	(4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️
																	
																	
																	(5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚

																	
																		
																		"Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts: 

																		
																			
																			(i) Arms Act, 1959
																			
																			
																			(ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
																			
																			
																			(iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
																			
																			
																			(iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
																			
																			
																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Personality Test 🗣️

															
																
																Marks: 50 Marks
																
																
																Note: The suitability of candidates will be determined by keeping in mind their efficiency, character, personality, and physical fitness.
																
															

															General Note:-

															
																
																The general knowledge syllabus is identical for both the preliminary and main examinations.
																
																
																The merit list will be prepared by adding the marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination and interview. 🏆

															Prelims Exam Plan and Syllabus 📝

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025
																
																
																Paper: General Knowledge & Law
																
																
																Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰
																
															

															Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠

															
																
																Total Questions: 50
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪
																	
																	
																	(2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍
																	
																	
																	(3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️
																	
																	
																	(6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️
																	
																
																
																
																Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics.
																
															

															Part-II: Law ⚖️

															
																
																Total Questions: 100
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: 30 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(2) The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: 25 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023: 25 Marks 👮
																	
																	
																	(4) U.P. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳

																Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳

																Total Papers: 6
																
																
																Total Marks: 500

																	(2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠
																	
																	
																	(4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️
																	
																	
																	(5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜

																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958

																Topics & Marks:

																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958

															Prelims Exam Plan and Syllabus 📝

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025
																
																
																Paper: General Knowledge & Law
																
																
																Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰
																
															

															Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠

															
																
																Total Questions: 50
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪
																	
																	
																	(2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍
																	
																	
																	(3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️
																	
																	
																	(6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️
																	
																
																
																
																Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics.
																
															

															Part-II: Law ⚖️

															
																
																Total Questions: 100
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: 30 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(2) The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: 25 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023: 25 Marks 👮
																	
																	
																	(4) U.P. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025
																
																
																Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination.
																
																
																Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳
																
															

															Written Examination

															
																
																Total Papers: 6
																
																
																Total Marks: 500
																
																
																Paper Details & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖
																	
																	
																	(2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠
																	
																	
																	(4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️
																	
																	
																	(5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚

																	
																		
																		"Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts: 

																		
																			
																			(i) Arms Act, 1959
																			
																			
																			(ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
																			
																			
																			(iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
																			
																			
																			(iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
																			
																			
																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958

															Prelims Exam Plan and Syllabus 📝

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Pre.) Exam-2025
																
																
																Paper: General Knowledge & Law
																
																
																Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰
																
															

															Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠

															
																
																Total Questions: 50
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪
																	
																	
																	(2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍
																	
																	
																	(3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️
																	
																	
																	(6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️
																	
																
																
																
																Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics.
																
															

															Part-II: Law ⚖️

															
																
																Total Questions: 100
																
																
																Topics & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023: 30 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(2) The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023: 25 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023: 25 Marks 👮
																	
																	
																	(4) U.P. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔
																	
																	
																	(5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️

															
																
																Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025
																
																
																Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination.
																
																
																Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳
																
															

															Written Examination

															
																
																Total Papers: 6
																
																
																Total Marks: 500
																
																
																Paper Details & Marks:

																
																	
																	(1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖
																	
																	
																	(2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝
																	
																	
																	(3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠
																	
																	
																	(4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️
																	
																	
																	(5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜
																	
																	
																	(6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚

																	
																		
																		"Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts: 

																		
																			
																			(i) Arms Act, 1959
																			
																			
																			(ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
																			
																			
																			(iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
																			
																			
																			(iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
																			
																			
																			(v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
																			
																			
																			(vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012
																			
																			
																			(vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908
																			
																			
																			(viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955
																			
																			
																			(ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
																			
																			
																			(x) Public Gambling Act, 1867
																			
																			
																			(xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956
																			
																			
																			(xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
																			
																			
																			(xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970
																			
																			
																			(xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
																			
																			
																			(xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983
																			
																			
																			(xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944
																			
																			
																			(xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861
																			
																			
																			(xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																
																
															

															 

															Personality Test 🗣️

															
																
																Marks: 50 Marks
																
																
																Note: The suitability of candidates will be determined by keeping in mind their efficiency, character, personality, and physical fitness.

																The general knowledge syllabus is identical for both the preliminary and main examinations.

Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔 (5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳   Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️ Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025 Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination. Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳ Written Examination Total Papers: 6 Total Marks: 500 Paper Details & Marks: (1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖 (2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝 (3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠 (4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️ (5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜 (6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚 "Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts:  (i) Arms Act, 1959 (ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 (iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012 (vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908 (viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 (x) Public Gambling Act, 1867 (xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 (xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986 (xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970 (xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983 (xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944 (xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861 (xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958   Personality Test 🗣️ Marks: 50 Marks Note: The suitability of candidates will be determined by keeping in mind their efficiency, character, personality, and physical fitness. General Note:- The general knowledge syllabus is identical for both the preliminary and main examinations. The merit list will be prepared by adding the marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination and interview. 🏆

Exam-2025 Paper: General Knowledge & Law Total Duration: 2 hours ⏰ Part-I: General Knowledge 🧠 Total Questions: 50 Topics & Marks: (1) General Science: 10 Marks 🧪 (2) Current Events and International Importance: 10 Marks 🌍 (3) History of India: 08 Marks 📜 (4) Indian National Movement: 08 Marks 🇮🇳 (5) Indian Polity & Economy: 08 Marks 🗳️ (6) World Geography and Population: 08 Marks 🗺️ Note: Candidates are expected to have general awareness about the above topics. Police And Regulations: 15 Marks 🚔 (5) Indian Constitution: 10 Marks 🇮🇳   Main Exam Plan and Syllabus ✍️ Exam Name: Assistant Prosecution Officer (Main) Exam-2025 Note: There will be 06 papers in the main examination. Duration: The duration of General English and General Knowledge papers will be one and a half hours, while the duration of all the other papers has been fixed at three hours each. ⏳ Written Examination Total Papers: 6 Total Marks: 500 Paper Details & Marks: (1) General Hindi (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 100 Marks 📖 (2) General English (Question Paper shall be of High School Standard): 50 Marks 📝 (3) General Knowledge: 50 Marks 🧠 (4) Criminal Law & Procedure: 100 Marks ⚖️ (5) Sakshya Adhiniyam: 100 Marks 📜 (6) Anya Adhiniyam (Other Acts): 100 Marks 📚 "Anya Adhiniyam" includes questions from the following Acts:  (i) Arms Act, 1959 (ii) Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (iii) Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 (iv) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (v) Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 (vi) Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012 (vii) Explosive Substances Act, 1908 (viii) Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (ix) Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 (x) Public Gambling Act, 1867 (xi) Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 (xii) Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986 (xiii) Uttar Pradesh Control of Goondas Act, 1970 (xiv) Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (xv) Uttar Pradesh Dacoity Affected Areas Act, 1983 (xvi) Uttar Pradesh Fire Service Act, 1944 (xvii) Uttar Pradesh Police Act, 1861 (xviii) Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Building Operations Act, 1958   Personality Test 🗣️ Marks: 50 Marks Note: The suitability of candidates will be determined by keeping in mind their efficiency, character, personality, and physical fitness. General Note:- The general knowledge syllabus is identical for both the preliminary and main examinations. The merit list will be prepared by adding the marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination and interview. 🏆
